phases.name: Foundations to a usable app
phases.plain: The base of Lodestar: the engine, the screens for searching and reading torrents, settings, the first-run wizard, filters and the safety rules. Finished through milestone 5.

phases.name: Release v0.5.1
phases.plain: The release you can install now. The code is built and the release candidate is signed. What is left is the 24-hour memory test on your Unraid box, then you tag it.

phases.name: Discover faster
phases.plain: The crawler finds about 12 torrents a minute. The v0.6 gate is 100 a minute. This work builds each idea behind an off switch, then measures it live on a dedicated host.

phases.name: More places to find torrents
phases.plain: Plug-ins that bring in torrents from feeds and indexes (Torznab, RSS, Internet Archive and others), with consent, a kill switch and the safety filters applied first.

phases.name: Bring in existing libraries
phases.plain: Import big collections from Magnetico and Bitmagnet, then prove Lodestar holds 1 million, 10 million and 50 million torrents within its speed and size budgets.

phases.name: Run it anywhere
phases.plain: Remote workers on other machines, the companion manager, and the finished packaging for Docker, Unraid and Windows. On hold until the memory test gives its verdict.

phases.name: Search and integrations
phases.plain: Torznab server, torrent upload, grouping of duplicates, regex search, enrichment plug-ins. Download clients and notifiers were built early and are done.

phases.name: Hardening to 1.0
phases.plain: Version 0.8 (plug-ins on workers), then the big relevance, performance, security and chaos checks that must pass before 1.0.

phases.name: Backlog, fixes and polish
phases.plain: Small fixes, review follow-ups and polish rounds that fill spare capacity. The runner launches these as they come up.
